**Indikator 2** measures the quality of initial diagnostic workups for patients with [[atrieflimren]] by tracking the proportion who receive an [[ekkokardiografi|Ekkokardiografi]] within a strict clinical timeframe—specifically, from six months before to three months after their first diagnosis date [^src3]. The data compares performance across [[danmark|Danmark]]'s five regions, specific health clusters, and individual hospitals over multiple reporting years, evaluating them against a national standard threshold of ≥80% [^src1]. Additional context, methodological appendices, and extended regional analyses supporting these indicators are detailed throughout the broader 2023 and 2024 annual reports [^src4] [^src5] [^src6] [^src7] [^src8] [^src9] [^src10] [^src11] [^src12] [^src13] [^src14] [^src15] [^src16] [^src17] [^src18] [^src19] [^src20] [^src21] [^src22] [^src23] [^src24] [^src25] [^src26] [^src27].

**Targets Met and Missed**
In the 2022/23 reporting period, the national average was 79.2%, meaning Denmark as a whole narrowly missed the ≥80% standard [^src1]. At the regional level, only [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] (82.2%) and [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] (88.5%) met the target, while [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] (70.9%), [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] (75.9%), and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] (78.7%) fell short [^src1]. By the 2023/24 period, the national average improved to 80.6%, successfully meeting the standard [^src2]. Region Nordjylland also crossed the threshold, reaching 80.2%, joining Midtjylland (86.5%) and Syddanmark (84.4%) in compliance [^src2]. Region Hovedstaden (74.5%) and Region Sjælland (78.0%) continued to miss the target in the latest period [^src2].

**Leaders and Trailers**
Hospital-level data for 2022/23 reveals stark disparities in clinical compliance. The clear leaders were [[friklinikken-region-syddanmark-grindsted|Friklinikken Region Syddanmark Grindsted]] at 98.8% and [[garantiklinikken|Garantiklinikken]] at 98.5% [^src1]. Conversely, the most significant trailer was [[sjaellands-universitetshospital-koenge|Sjællands Universitetshospital Køge]], which recorded a stark outlier value of just 45.6% [^src1]. Other notable low performers included [[herlev-og-gentofte-hospital|Herlev og Gentofte Hospital]] (63.0%) and [[bispebjerg-og-frederiksberg-hospitaler|Bispebjerg og Frederiksberg Hospitaler]] (64.3%) [^src1]. In the 2023/24 data, which aggregates some areas into health clusters, [[sundhedsklynge-lillebaelt|Sundhedsklynge Lillebælt]] led with 89.4%, while [[sundhedsklynge-bornholm|Sundhedsklynge Bornholm]] missed the standard at 78.1% [^src2].

**Trends Over Time**
The data demonstrates a consistent upward trend in echocardiography compliance across most geographies. Nationally, the proportion rose from 76.0% in 2020/21 to 76.8% in 2021/22, before reaching 79.2% in 2022/23 and 80.6% in 2023/24 [^src1] [^src2]. Region Hovedstaden showed steady, albeit insufficient, improvement, climbing from 65.5% in 2020/21 to 74.5% in 2023/24 [^src1] [^src2]. Region Midtjylland has consistently been the top-performing region, maintaining high compliance rates between 86.5% and 88.5% across the last three recorded periods [^src1] [^src2].
